generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2x2 atlas of game-map mountain hatching texture patches
Primary request: create four distinct sparse mountain-ridge hatching brush clusters, one isolated cluster centered in each quadrant, for a restrained ancient Chinese strategic map overlay
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local removal
Subject: top-left low elongated ridge with sparse dry-brush hatch marks; top-right gentle folded mountain chain; bottom-left layered basin-edge contour strokes; bottom-right broken rocky ridge strokes
Style/medium: original hand-drawn Chinese cartographic ink hatching, restrained dry-brush linework, muted dark olive-brown ink, simple bold silhouette that survives reduction, no imitation of any commercial Three Kingdoms game
Composition/framing: exact 2x2 atlas, four equal quadrants, one compact horizontal cluster per quadrant, generous empty padding, no dividers
Constraints: background must be one perfectly uniform #00ff00 color with no gradients, paper grain, lighting, shadow, floor, reflection or texture; do not use green or #00ff00 in the ink clusters; no text, no Chinese characters, no labels, no map, no coastline, no rivers, no roads, no cities, no borders, no icons, no watermark; clusters must remain visually subordinate when drawn at low opacity
Avoid: any red, magenta, purple or bright-colored edge highlights

runtime_boundary.meaning: visual brushwork only; not a reconstructed mountain footprint or boundary
